description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and acrificing Worldspine Wurm.
When Worldspine Wurm dies, its first and second ability trigger, as well as Verdant Succession.
Resolve the first Worldspine Wurm trigger, creating three 5/5 Wurm creature tokens.
Resolve the second Worldspine Wurm trigger, shuffling it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Worldspine Wurm and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Worldspine Wurm enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
